data.cultural_impact: Historically, Hinckley is famous as the home town of Wilford Woodruff, who became the fourth President of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints in 1848. The town is also well-known for its annual 'Hinckley Nottingham Carnival' which is the largest Carnival in the world outside of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. This vibrant event has been running since 1902 and attracts thousands of visitors every year.
